title: List dconf keys in a directory
summary: View all sub-keys and sub-directories under a specific path in the dconf database to find the exact key you need.

steps.explain: List all keys and sub-directories under a specific path. Replace <DIR_PATH> with the directory path, e.g., org/gnome/desktop/interface/.

placeholders.name: DIR_PATH
placeholders.description: The directory path to list, starting with /
